From my knowledge, chronic metallic mercury poisoning, also known as mercurialism, is associated with certain symptoms:

- Irritability
- Tremors (especially intention tremor)
- Cognitive deficits
- Erythema
- Proteinuria

Given these typical symptoms, option B seems to align well with the known symptoms of chronic metallic mercury poisoning.
